galaxy.sim: STARFORGE / SILCC GMC & H II Bubble

frame.name: disk
frame.definition: d = R (x_box_kpc - center_kpc); cube axes (i,j,k) = (x_d, y_d, z_d), z_d along Lhat

order: x-fastest: index = i + n*(j + n*k); voxel centre = -half_kpc + (i + 0.5) * voxel_kpc

webp.map: part p, slice k = 64p + s; pixel (x = (s % 16)*n + i, y = floor(s / 16)*n + j)

gz.star_raw: 4 n^3 bytes RGBA, A = 255 if R|G|B else 0

vx.label: v_x
vx.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a = 1) minus SubhaloVel, rotated to the disk frame (component x = xhat); no Hubble flow
vx.frame: disk (xhat, yhat, Lhat), relative to SubhaloVel

vy.label: v_y
vy.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a = 1) minus SubhaloVel, rotated to the disk frame (component y = yhat); no Hubble flow
vy.frame: disk (xhat, yhat, Lhat), relative to SubhaloVel

vz.label: v_z
vz.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a = 1) minus SubhaloVel, rotated to the disk frame (component z = Lhat); no Hubble flow
vz.frame: disk (xhat, yhat, Lhat), relative to SubhaloVel

v.frame: disk (xhat, yhat, Lhat), relative to SubhaloVel

stars.units: L_AB0 kpc^-3 (L_AB0 = luminosity of an M_AB = 0 source)
